# Summary

Describe what changed and the user-visible effect.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated when needed
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make build` passes
- [ ] Generated colorschemes were regenerated when templates or palette logic changed
- [ ] README, changelog, or Vim help updated when needed

## Additional context

Include screenshots for visual changes and note any compatibility or migration
considerations.
